about: Measured bridges whose AHN deck range (deckRangeM) is far shorter than the water the road crosses, so the road runs over open water with no deck at either end (a 'stub'). Each entry replaces `deck` (metres along the road way, DeckProfile.deck) after eyeballing the orthophoto. Applied by extend-decks.py to a STAGING copy of elevation-v1/bridges.json.

extensions.name: Gevlebrug
